{{Field procedure|summary=Prepare a ship for a first mining run and complete the basic loop of finding, extracting, refining, and selling mined commodities.}}

This procedure gives a first-run mining checklist. It assumes a commander wants a practical loop rather than a perfect profit build.

{{Draft warning}}

== Before you undock ==

* Choose a method: [[Laser Mining]] is the simplest starting point; [[Core Mining]], [[Sub-surface Mining]], and [[Surface Deposit Mining]] require more specialized handling.
* Fit the extraction tool for that method.
* Fit a [[Refinery]], [[Collector Limpet Controller]], cargo racks, and limpets.
* Fit a [[Prospector Limpet Controller]] unless the procedure for the chosen method says otherwise.
* Leave cargo room for mined commodities after loading limpets.

== Procedure ==

{{Procedure steps|
# Pick a target ring, hotspot, or known mining location.
# Travel to the location and drop into the ring safely.
# Prospect candidate asteroids before spending time extracting from them.
# Extract with the method-specific tool: mining laser, seismic charges, sub-surface displacement missile, or abrasion blaster.
# Keep collector limpets active while fragments or chunks are available.
# Watch the refinery and clear unwanted blocked bins if necessary.
# When the hold is ready, check current market demand and sell prices before choosing a station or carrier.
}}

== Completion check ==

The run is complete when refined commodities have been sold or stored and the ship has enough fuel, limpets, and cargo space for the next decision.

== Common problems ==

* '''No cargo is appearing:''' check that a refinery is installed and powered, and that cargo space is available.
* '''Collectors are not bringing the right fragments:''' use the ignore workflow for unwanted commodities and clear refinery bins.
* '''The refinery is stuck:''' see [[How to Resolve a Full Refinery]].
* '''The sell station changed:''' mining prices and demand are time-sensitive; re-check current market data before travelling far.
